This module's subpage serves as a centralized location for archivedate values on {{Tl|{{{1|{{#ifeq:{{SUBPAGENAME}}|doc|{{#titleparts:{{FULLPAGENAME}}|-1|-2}}|{{SUBPAGENAME}}}}}}}}} entries. It can still be overridden by using archivedate= or archiveurl= on {{Tl|{{{1|{{#ifeq:{{SUBPAGENAME}}|doc|{{#titleparts:{{FULLPAGENAME}}|-1|-2}}|{{SUBPAGENAME}}}}}}}}}, but if neither of those values is given, this subpage will provide a default archivedate.
